claims.claim: The module declares its network writes, inputs, outputs, lifecycle, and refused authority.
claims.pass_condition: Manifest and module contract validate and schemas parse; merge, force, branch deletion, promotion, roots, and CANON paths are refused.
claims.primary_surface: module contract verifier plus parsed JSON artifacts
claims.counterevidence: Invalid contract, missing side effect, or undeclared permission.
claims.observed_evidence: Focused selftest assertions and required Workshop verifier.
claims.named_seam: A valid contract declares behavior but does not prove remote transport.

claims.claim: The same packets and local/remote facts produce the same plan digest and typed drift or authority holds.
claims.pass_condition: Repeated fixture plans match; packet tamper, dirty state, base drift, non-fast-forward state, wrong lane, missing auth, and ambiguous PRs are held.
claims.primary_surface: focused execution with temporary Git fixture
claims.counterevidence: Digest changes for semantic-equivalent input or any refused state produces READY.
claims.named_seam: Remote facts are observations and must be rebuilt immediately before publication.

claims.claim: Only explicit checkpointed feature-branch push and draft PR upsert are executable.
claims.pass_condition: Wrong confirmation is refused; command trace contains no force, stage, commit, reset, checkout, ready, close, merge, branch deletion, promotion, roots, or CANON action.
claims.primary_surface: allowed and denied mocked host command traces
claims.counterevidence: Any prohibited command is reachable or credential material appears in a receipt.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: source invocation audit and host pre-push hook
claims.observed_evidence: Focused boundary assertions plus receiver-confirmed draft PR 33 bootstrap publication; the receipt reports merge false and all wider authority false.
claims.named_seam: The host GitHub session supplies transport authority; the tool never owns the credential.

claims.claim: A successful publication binds the sent head to both the remote branch and GitHub PR receiver state.
claims.pass_condition: Sender push succeeds, receiver branch head equals checkpoint head, PR readback equals head/base/title/body, and the receipt verifies.
claims.primary_surface: real self-publication sender and GitHub receiver receipt tied by exact head
claims.counterevidence: Remote or PR readback differs, receiver cannot be queried, or only the sender reports success.
claims.secondary_surface_if_needed: mocked transport matrix and external final-head handoff receipt
claims.observed_evidence: Draft PR 33 bootstrap receipt PASS at exact head 911a8a695d59be6cc1751a399b167a016afb0200; receipt verification PASS; both GitHub checks passed.
claims.named_seam: The committed bootstrap receipt proves the executable code head; the final evidence-only head requires its separate external receiver receipt.
